## Try It Out!
### Send SMS booking notifications from Sharetribe via Twilio

Send instant SMS notifications when a booking is confirmed on your marketplace. SMS ensures providers never miss a booking, even when they're away from email.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for the accept/confirm transition that indicates a booking is confirmed.
* Twilio sends an SMS to the provider's phone number with booking details.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Twilio account (Account SID and Auth Token).
3. Set the "From" number in the Twilio node to your Twilio phone number.
4. Update the transition name to match your booking confirmation transition.
5. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Twilio account with an SMS-capable phone number

### How to customize
* Add a Sharetribe Get User node to fetch the provider's phone number dynamically.
* Change the transition filter for different booking states.
* Modify the SMS message content.
* Add a second Twilio node to also notify the customer.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events to catch booking confirmations.

## 2. Filter for booking confirmation
Only continues when the transition indicates a booking has been accepted or confirmed.

## 3. Send SMS notification
Sends an SMS via Twilio to the provider. Update the phone number to come from the provider's profile or a Set node.
